title: Apple
description: Apple Inc. is a technology company known for its innovative products such as the iPhone, iPad, Mac computers, and Apple Watch. Founded in 1976, it also offers services like the App Store, Apple Music, and iCloud.

title: Android
description: Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google. Launched in 2008, it powers a wide range of smartphones and tablets. It is known for its customization options, Google services integration, and a vast app ecosystem through the Google Play Store.

title: Linux
description: Linux is an open-source operating system kernel that is widely used in servers, desktops, and embedded systems. Launched in 1991 by Linus Torvalds, it is known for its stability, security, and flexibility. Popular distributions include Ubuntu, Fedora, and Debian.

title: Windows
description: Windows is a series of operating systems developed by Microsoft. Launched in 1985, it is known for its graphical user interface and widespread use in personal computers. Key features include the Start menu, taskbar, and support for a wide range of software applications.
